warningTiers.0: Green, System message. Used for peer to peer anouncements or system notifications
warningTiers.1: yellow, Alert. Used for minor warnings, addressable after race or with minor driving alterations
warningTiers.2: orange, Warn. Used for moderate warnings, address at next avalible stop or alter driving immediately
warningTiers.3: Red, Emergency. Used for major warnings, stop and address immediately

Dead Battery.message: Battery is below minimum threshold. Charge or replace
